description:
Scholarship Overview

La Trobe University, a leading public research university in Melbourne, Australia, offers a comprehensive range of scholarships for international students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs. These scholarships are designed to reward academic excellence, support students in AI-related fields, and provide opportunities for those from humanitarian backgrounds. Each scholarship has its own eligibility criteria, benefits, and application process.

Available Scholarships

1. La Trobe Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship

  • Type: Merit-based
  • Coverage: Full tuition fees plus AUD $5,000 annual stipend
  • Eligibility: New international students with exceptional academic achievement applying for undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs
  • Application: Automatic consideration upon admission application by the deadline
  • Official Link: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/la-trobe-vice-chancellor-scholarship

2. La Trobe Artificial Intelligence Scholarship

  • Type: Merit-based
  • Coverage: 50% or 100% of annual tuition fees
  • Eligibility: International students applying for AI-related courses such as Bachelor of Computer Science (AI major), Master of Artificial Intelligence, Master of Data Science, or Bachelor of Information Technology
  • Application: Automatic consideration upon admission to eligible AI course
  • Official Link: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/la-trobe-artificial-intelligence-scholarship-50-and-100

3. La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship

  • Type: Merit-based
  • Coverage: 20% to 25% discount on annual tuition fees
  • Eligibility: New international students with strong academic grades (typically 85%+ in previous studies) applying for undergraduate or postgraduate programs
  • Application: Automatic consideration upon admission application
  • Official Link: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/search

4. La Trobe Humanitarian Scholarship (International)

  • Type: Equity-based
  • Coverage: Full tuition fees plus AUD $5,000 per year stipend
  • Eligibility: International students on humanitarian visas or refugee backgrounds, demonstrating financial need, enrolled in full-time face-to-face undergraduate program
  • Application: Separate application form required with supporting documents
  • Official Link: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/la-trobe-humanitarian-scholarship

5. Other Faculty and Course-Specific Scholarships

  • Type: Merit or Equity-based
  • Coverage: Variable (e.g., AUD $36,000 - $46,000 total)
  • Eligibility: Specific courses or fields such as Criminology, Engineering, IT, Nursing, Law
  • Application: Check individual scholarship criteria and deadlines via the official search portal
  • Official Link: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/search

Application Process

  1. Choose your desired course at La Trobe University (e.g., Bachelor of Nursing, Master of Information Technology).
  2. Apply for admission through the university's online application portal.
  3. Check scholarship eligibility. Most scholarships are automatically considered upon admission application. Some (like the Humanitarian Scholarship) require a separate application.
  4. Submit all required documents including transcripts and English proficiency scores.
  5. Await decision. The university will notify you of the scholarship outcome along with your admission offer.

About La Trobe University

La Trobe University is a public university in Victoria, Australia, with its main campus in Melbourne's Bundoora area. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research degrees across health, science, business, education and the humanities. Its teaching and research connect metropolitan and regional communities with professional practice, academic inquiry and industry partnerships.

Official website: https://www.latrobe.edu.au

Why Choose La Trobe University?

La Trobe University is a public research university located in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. It is known for its industry-focused courses and practical learning. The university offers strong programs in Nursing, IT, Cybersecurity, Criminology, Law, and Science. The Department of Computer Science and Information Technology is at the forefront of cybersecurity teaching, research, and policy development.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I apply for multiple scholarships?

A: Generally, a student can accept only one major scholarship at a time. However, in some cases, a tuition fee discount can be combined with a smaller bursary or grant. Always check the scholarship's official terms and conditions.

Q: How is the scholarship money paid?

A: Tuition fee scholarships (like the Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship) are adjusted directly against your tuition fees. Cash stipends (like AUD $5,000 annual) are transferred to your Australian bank account, usually per semester or per year.

Q: Is the scholarship renewed annually?

A: Yes, provided you remain full-time enrolled and demonstrate satisfactory academic progress. Failure to maintain full-time status or good academic standing may result in cancellation of the scholarship.

Q: Are there scholarships for La Trobe College Australia (LCA)?

A: Yes, LCA offers scholarships for international students undertaking Foundation or Diploma programs. These may have different value and eligibility criteria. Check the LCA website for details.

Official Links

  • Main Scholarships Page: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/study/scholarships/other/search
  • International Student Scholarships: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/international/scholarships
  • La Trobe College Australia Scholarships: https://www.latrobecollegeaustralia.edu.au/foundation-and-diploma-scholarships
  • Admission Application Portal: https://www.latrobe.edu.au/international/how-to-apply

Important Notes

  • Choose your course first, then check scholarship options. Scholarship application requires course application.
  • Always verify details on the official La Trobe University website.
  • Application process takes time. Apply as early as possible.
  • Contact the International Student Support team for any confusion.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 January 2027 (Varies by Scholarship). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
